programme.title: Case 39
programme.desc: In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins (Renée Zellweger) thinks she has seen it all -- until she meets 10-year-old Lilith (Jodelle Ferland) and the girl's cruel parents. When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters. - Renée Zellweger, Jodelle Ferland, Ian McShane, Bradley Cooper, Adrian Lester (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery. - Naomi Watts, Martin Henderson, David Dorfman, Brian Cox, Jane Alexander (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay. - Alison Lohman, Justin Long, Lorna Raver, Dileep Rao, David Paymer (Horror, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Jim Broadbent, Gemma Jones (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble. - Adam Sandler, Jennifer Aniston, Nicole Kidman, Brooklyn Decker, Nick Swardson (Comedy, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy)

programme.title: My Cousin Vinny
programme.desc: New York lawyer Vinny has never won a case. When his teenage cousin Bill and his friend Stan are accused of murder in a backwater Alabama town, it's up to the nervous Vinny to save him from jail, even though he's only ever tried personal injury cases before, and none of them successfully. - Joe Pesci, Marisa Tomei, Ralph Macchio, Mitchell Whitfield, Fred Gwynne (Comedy, Drama, Movie)

programme.title: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart. - Julianne Hough, Diego Boneta, Russell Brand, Alec Baldwin, Tom Cruise (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Music, Musical)

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Dracula becomes overprotective when a human boy discovers his monsters-only resort during a birthday celebration and falls for his teenage daughter. - Charly Luske, Ferry Doedens, Liza Sips, Selena Gomez, Adam Sandler (Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy, Family)

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Set in 1985, Adam Sandler plays a nice guy with a broken heart who's stuck in one of the most romantic jobs in the world, a wedding singer. He loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancé. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married. - Adam Sandler, Drew Barrymore, Christine Taylor, Allen Covert, Matthew Glave (Comedy, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble. - Adam Sandler, Jennifer Aniston, Nicole Kidman, Brooklyn Decker, Nick Swardson (Comedy, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Killer Joe
programme.desc: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple). - Matthew McConaughey, Emile Hirsch, Juno Temple, Thomas Haden Church, Gina Gershon (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Smart People
programme.desc: Acerbic, selfish and widowed, literature professor Lawrence Wetherhold (Dennis Quaid) is estranged from his son and his overachieving teenage daughter. Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life. - Dennis Quaid, Sarah Jessica Parker, Thomas Haden Church, Elliot Page, Ashton Holmes (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Afflicted
programme.desc: Two friends' tour of Europe takes a dark turn when one of them contracts a mysterious illness. They race to find out what it is and how to cure it before the sickness consumes him completely. - Clif Prowse, Derek Lee, Baya Rehaz, Edo van Breemen, Zachary Gray (Horror, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. - Nicole Kidman, Matthew Broderick, Bette Midler, Glenn Close, Christopher Walken (Comedy, Dark comedy, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction)

programme.title: Where the Wild Things Are
programme.desc: Feeling misunderstood at home and at school, mischievous Max (Max Records) escapes to the land of the Wild Things, majestic -- and sometimes fierce -- creatures. They allow Max to become their leader, and he promises to create a kingdom where everyone will be happy. However, Max soon finds that being king is not easy and that, even being with the Wild Things, there is something missing. - Catherine Keener, Max Records, Mark Ruffalo, James Gandolfini, Lauren Ambrose (Adventure, Children, Drama, Family, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: The Brothers Grimm, Wilhelm and Jacob, are dysfunctional schemers who go from town to town putting on shows that convince inhabitants they are getting rid of demons. After one such scam, a mysterious man called Cavaldi brings them to a French general, who persuades them to battle the evil that has kidnapped 10 girls from a small village. During the investigation, the cynical Wilhelm and sensitive Jacob see things that point to real magic at work. - Matt Damon, Heath Ledger, Peter Stormare, Lena Headey, Monica Bellucci (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Movie)

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. - Jason Bateman, Rachel McAdams, Kyle Chandler, Sharon Horgan, Billy Magnussen (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie, Mystery)

programme.title: Dumb Money
programme.desc: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. - Paul Dano, Pete Davidson, Vincent D'Onofrio, Shailene Woodley, America Ferrera (Biography, Comedy, Comedy drama, Docudrama, Drama)

programme.title: Blockers
programme.desc: Julie, Kayla and Sam are three high school seniors who make a pact to lose their virginity on prom night. Lisa, Mitchell and Hunter are three overprotective parents who flip out when they find out about their daughters' plans. They soon join forces for a wild and chaotic quest to stop the girls from sealing the deal -- no matter what the cost. - Leslie Mann, Ike Barinholtz, John Cena, Kathryn Newton, Geraldine Viswanathan (Comedy, Drama, Movie)

programme.title: Barbie
programme.desc: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans. - Margot Robbie, Ryan Gosling, America Ferrera, Ariana Greenblatt, Issa Rae (Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Movie)

programme.title: Flight Risk
programme.desc: A U.S. marshal boards a small plane to transfer a government witness to New York. As they cross the Alaskan wilderness, tensions start to rise as not everyone on the flight is who they appear to be. - Mark Wahlberg, Michelle Dockery, Topher Grace, Leah Remini, Maaz Ali (Action, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: The Equalizer 3
programme.desc: Since giving up his life as a government assassin, Robert McCall finds solace in serving justice on behalf of the oppressed. Now living in Southern Italy, he soon discovers his new friends are under the control of local crime bosses. As events turn deadly, McCall becomes their protector by taking on the mafia. - Denzel Washington, Dakota Fanning, David Denman, Eugenio Mastrandrea, Gaia Scodellaro (Action, Crime, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: The Amateur (New)
programme.desc: Charlie Heller is a brilliant CIA decoder whose world comes crashing down when his wife dies in a London terrorist attack. When his supervisors refuse to take action, his intelligence becomes the ultimate weapon as he embarks on a dangerous trek across the globe to track down those responsible. - Rami Malek, Rachel Brosnahan, Laurence Fishburne, Holt McCallany, Danny Sapani (Action, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Ready Player One
programme.desc: In 2045, the creator of a virtual reality universe promises his fortune to the first person to discover a digital Easter egg. Soon, young Wade Watts finds himself in a reality-bending treasure hunt through the mysterious and fantastical world. - Tye Sheridan, Olivia Cooke, Ben Mendelsohn, Lena Waithe, T.J. Miller (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction)

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express
programme.desc: A lavish trip through Europe quickly unfolds into a race against time to solve a murder aboard a train. When an avalanche stops the Orient Express dead in its tracks, the world's greatest detective -- Hercule Poirot -- arrives to interrogate all passengers and search for clues before the killer can strike again. - Kenneth Branagh, Johnny Depp, Michelle Pfeiffer, Tom Bateman, Josh Gad (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Mystery)

programme.title: Alabama Snake
programme.desc: The story of Pentecostal minister Glenn Summerford, a man accused of attempting to murder his wife with a rattlesnake in the sleepy town of Scottsboro, Alabama, and the investigation and trial that haunted Southern Appalachia for decades. - Brian Brightman, Erin Carere, Cliff Craig, Glenn Summerford, Darlene Summerford (Crime, Documentary, Show, Special)

programme.title: Siren: The Voices of Shelley Beattie
programme.desc: A dual portrait of actor Marlee Matlin and American Gladiator Shelley Beattie, aka Siren; deafness defined both of their lives in similar and different ways. - Shelley Beattie, Marlee Matlin, John Romano, Ed Connors, Bill Koch (Biography, Documentary, Event, Show, Special)

programme.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
programme.desc: The battle for NINJAGO City calls to action young Master Builder Lloyd, aka the Green Ninja, along with his friends, also secret ninja warriors. Led by Master Wu, as wise-cracking as he is wise, they must defeat the evil warlord Garmadon, who also happens to be Lloyd's dad. Pitting father against son, the epic showdown tests these fierce but undisciplined modern-day ninjas as they learn to check their egos and pull together to unleash the inner power of Spinjitzu. - Jackie Chan, Dave Franco, Fred Armisen, Justin Theroux, Abbi Jacobson (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children)

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: After 10 years of marriage and two children, it seems that Greg Focker has finally earned a place in the "circle of trust" of his uptight father-in-law, Jack. However, Greg is moonlighting with a drug company, which raises Jack's suspicions. As two clans descend on the scene of the young twins' birthday party, Greg must find a way through myriad misunderstandings to prove to Jack -- once and for all -- that he is worthy of being the next family patriarch. - Robert De Niro, Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson, Dustin Hoffman, Barbra Streisand (Comedy, Movie, Romance)

programme.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
programme.desc: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. - Bruce Willis, Jai Courtney, Sebastian Koch, Yuliya Snigir, Radivoje Bukvić (Action, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: The Maltese Falcon
programme.desc: In San Francisco, wealthy Ruth Wonderly (Bebe Daniels) hires amorous gumshoe Sam Spade (Ricardo Cortez) and his partner, Miles Archer, to trail her sister's kidnapper, Floyd Thursby. Wonderly's story is revealed as a ruse when both Archer and Thursby are later found murdered. Soon, Spade discovers that Wonderly and three other criminal oddballs -- including rotund Casper Gutman (Dudley Digges) -- are in search of an elusive jewel-covered statuette known as "the Maltese Falcon." - Bebe Daniels, Ricardo Cortez, Dudley Digges, Una Merkel, Robert Elliott (Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Mystery)

programme.title: Mortal Kombat
programme.desc: Lord Raiden (Christopher Lambert) handpicks three martial artists — federal agent Sonya Blade (Bridgette Wilson), Shaolin monk Liu Kang (Robin Shou) and action movie sensation Johnny Cage (Linden Ashby) — and mentors them. After intense training, Raiden transports the trio to Outworld, the site of an interdimensional fighting tournament. There, the three humans must defeat the demonic warriors of the evil Shang Tsung (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa) — or allow Tsung to take over the Earth. - Robin Shou, Linden Ashby, Bridgette Wilson, Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa, Christopher Lambert (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie)

programme.title: Mortal Kombat Annihilation
programme.desc: Every generation, a portal opens up between the Outerworld and Earth. Emperor Shao Kahn (Brian Thompson), ruler of the mythical Outerworld, pounces the moment the portal reopens and slips through with his mighty warriors, intent on total domination and uniting the two worlds. However, he has only seven days to complete his task. In the meantime, opposition grows and warriors Sonya Blade (Sandra Hess), Jax (Lynn "Red" Williams), Kitana (Talisa Soto) and Liu Kang (Robin Shou) get ready for war. - Robin Shou, Talisa Soto, James Remar, Brian Thompson, Sandra Hess (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction)

programme.title: Mortal Kombat
programme.desc: Lord Raiden (Christopher Lambert) handpicks three martial artists — federal agent Sonya Blade (Bridgette Wilson), Shaolin monk Liu Kang (Robin Shou) and action movie sensation Johnny Cage (Linden Ashby) — and mentors them. After intense training, Raiden transports the trio to Outworld, the site of an interdimensional fighting tournament. programme.title: Mortal Kombat II
programme.desc: Johnny Cage joins other fighters in the ultimate, no-holds-barred battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn, a powerful tyrant who threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders. - Karl Urban, Adeline Rudolph, Jessica McNamee, Ludi Lin, Martyn Ford (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial arts, Movie)

programme.title: They Will Kill You
programme.desc: A woman answers a cryptic ad for a housekeeping job at a luxurious yet foreboding New York City high-rise. Upon arrival, she discovers residents have vanished without a trace for decades, fueling whispers of a satanic cult lurking in the shadows. - Zazie Beetz, Myha'la, Paterson Joseph, Patricia Arquette, Tom Felton (Action, Comedy, Horror, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: The Moment
programme.desc: As her arena tour debut looms, a pop star finds herself caught inside the afterglow of a breakout summer under the mounting pressure of what it costs to stay on top. - Charli XCX, Rosanna Arquette, Kate Berlant, Alexander Skarsgård, Hailey Benton Gates (Comedy, Comedy drama, Movie, Music, Thriller)

programme.title: Pillion
programme.desc: A timid man is swept off his feet when an enigmatic, impossibly handsome biker takes him on as his submissive. - Alexander Skarsgård, Harry Melling, Douglas Hodge, Lesley Sharp, Jake Shears (Comedy, Comedy drama, Dark comedy, Drama, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
programme.desc: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace. Eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she's returned to them. However, what should be a joyful reunion soon turns into a living nightmare as she starts to transform into something truly horrifying. - Jack Reynor, Laia Costa, May Calamawy, Natalie Grace, Shylo Molina (Horror, Movie, Mystery)

programme.title: Stopping The Steal
programme.desc: An inside account of President Trump's challenge to the results of the 2020 presidential election as told by former White House staff and appointees. - Alyssa Farah Griffin, William Barr, Ronald Hansen, Marc Short, Greg Jacob (Documentary, Movie)

programme.desc: Mariska Hargitay's journey to understand and embrace the public and private legacy of her mother, Hollywood icon Jayne Mansfield. - Mariska Hargitay, Jayne Mansfield, Jayne Marie Mansfield, Mickey Hargitay Jr., Zoltan Hargitay (Documentary, Movie)

programme.title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
programme.desc: Exploring the rise of a boundary-pushing, sex-positive, cable-access pioneer who became an accidental AIDS-era lifeline and First Amendment fighter; at 70, with 600 shows behind her, she considers her place in the history she created. - Sandra Bernhard, Robin Byrd, Annie Sprinkle, Cheri Oteri, Daylon Orr (Documentary, Show, Special)

programme.title: The Last Samurai
programme.desc: Capt. Nathan Algren (Tom Cruise) is an American military officer hired by the Emperor of Japan to train the country's first army in the art of modern warfare. As the government attempts to eradicate the ancient Samurai warrior class in preparation for more Westernized and trade-friendly policies, Algren finds himself unexpectedly affected by his encounters with the Samurai, which places him at the center of a struggle between two eras and two worlds. - Tom Cruise, Ken Watanabe, Timothy Spall, Tony Goldwyn, Hiroyuki Sanada (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, War)

programme.title: Coraline
programme.desc: While exploring her new home, a girl named Coraline (Dakota Fanning) discovers a secret door, behind which lies an alternate world that closely mirrors her own but, in many ways, is better. She rejoices in her discovery, until Other Mother (Teri Hatcher) and the rest of her parallel family try to keep her there forever. Coraline must use all her resources and bravery to make it back to her own family and life. - Dakota Fanning, Teri Hatcher, Jennifer Saunders, Dawn French, Keith David (Animated, Animation, Children, Family, Fantasy)

programme.title: ParaNorman
programme.desc: Young Norman Babcock (Kodi Smit-McPhee) has the ability to speak with the dead -- and he often prefers their company to that of the living. When zombies rise from their graves, Norman must summon all his courage and compassion and push his paranormal abilities to the limit to save his fellow townspeople. - Kodi Smit-McPhee, Tucker Albrizzi, Anna Kendrick, Casey Affleck, Christopher Mintz-Plasse (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy)

programme.title: Kubo and the Two Strings

His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. programme.title: The Layover
programme.desc: Best friends Kate and Meg find themselves competing for the same man while waiting for their plane to take off from St. Louis. - Alexandra Daddario, Kate Upton, Matt Barr, Matt Jones, Molly Shannon (Comedy)

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes. (Anthology)

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. - Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant, Colin Firth, Jim Broadbent, Gemma Jones (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: In the fast-paced world of NASCAR, a rivalry brews between rookie hotshot Cole Trickle (Tom Cruise) and veteran racer Rowdy Burns (Michael Rooker). When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes). - Tom Cruise, Robert Duvall, Nicole Kidman, Randy Quaid, Michael Rooker (Action, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice. - Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon, Josh Brolin, Barry Pepper, Hailee Steinfeld (Western, Drama, Adventure)

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space. - Sandra Bullock, George Clooney, Adam Cozens (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. - Rachel McAdams, Cillian Murphy, Brian Cox, Jayma Mays, Jack Scalia (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery)

programme.title: A Perfect Murder
programme.desc: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. - Michael Douglas, Gwyneth Paltrow, Viggo Mortensen, David Suchet, Sarita Choudhury (Thriller)

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status. - Scarlett Johansson, Jonathan Rhys-Meyers, Emily Mortimer, Matthew Goode, Brian Cox (Drama)

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: A woman's (Rooney Mara) world unravels after her psychiatrist (Jude Law) prescribes a new medication to treat her anxiety.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Telling fortunes to support herself and her daughter, a psychic widow (Cate Blanchett) assists the police in a missing persons case.

programme.title: 4:44 Last Day on Earth
programme.desc: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning.

programme.title: The Silent Planet
programme.desc: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth.

programme.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Michael and Madison Roland are a married couple; Michael Roland’s controlling behavior leads a pregnant Madison Roland to leave the home; she later discovers that her previous circumstances continue to affect her current life.

programme.title: The Last Exorcism Part II
programme.desc: Unable to remember the horrific events of her past, Nell Sweetzer tries to rebuild her life in New Orleans. However, a demonic force soon returns with sinister plans for her.

programme.title: View From the Top
programme.desc: A woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) from a small Nevada town makes friends while training to become a flight attendant.

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally...
programme.desc: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: When an inmate is granted one weekend of freedom to see her dying mother, a rookie correction officer struggles to keep her under control.

programme.title: Flypaper
programme.desc: A man tries to protect a teller, whom he secretly loves, after two groups rob her bank at the same time.

programme.title: Blindness
programme.desc: A doctor's wife is one of the few individuals immune to a strange epidemic that causes people to lose their eyesight.

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: A one-of-a-kind, cyber-enhanced soldier (Scarlett Johansson) must battle a new enemy who can hack into people's minds and control them.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: A man and his wife move to a quaint suburb where most of the women seem to have the same bland personality.

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to the life he has abandoned.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: A strong-willed woman (Shirley MacLaine) and her equally independent daughter (Debra Winger) keep the lines of communication open as each deals with the curveballs life throws at them.

programme.title: You Can Count on Me
programme.desc: Sammy is a single mother who is extremely protective of her 8-year-old son. She is satisfied with living in the small town she grew up in and working in a local bank. When her brother Terry visits he fits the void in the life of both her and her son. Temporarily free of the constraints of single motherhood she begins to break free of her normal routine. In a string of traumatic events Sammy is torn between helping her brother and her maternal instinct to protect her son from getting hurt. - Laura Linney, Mark Ruffalo, Rory Culkin, Matthew Broderick, Jon Tenney (Drama)

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit. - Mila Kunis, Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn, Cheryl Hines, Christine Baranski (Holiday, Comedy)

programme.title: Life During Wartime
programme.desc: Nothing comes easily for Joy (Shirley Henderson) and her sisters, Trish (Allison Janney) and Helen (Ally Sheedy). Joy, unhappy with her job and her sleazy husband (Michael Kenneth Williams), is haunted by her dead boyfriend's ghost (Paul Reubens). Trish's pedophile husband (Ciarán Hinds) is behind bars, and she's ready to move on with her life. As an increasingly bitter Helen approaches middle age with a failing screenwriting career, it becomes clear her mother offers little comfort. - Shirley Henderson, Ciarán Hinds, Allison Janney, Michael Lerner, Chris Marquette (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Hard Truths
programme.desc: Pansy, angry and depressed, lashes out at family and strangers. Her constant criticism isolates her, except from her cheerful sister Chantelle, who remains sympathetic despite their differences. - Marianne Jean-Baptiste, Michele Austin, David Webber, Tuwaine Barrett, Sophia Brown (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. - Tessa Thompson, Whoopi Goldberg, Melissa Leo, La La Anthony, Drena De Niro (Comedy)

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Starting a new job can be a difficult challenge, especially if you're already retired. Looking to get back into the game, 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker seizes the opportunity to become a senior intern at an online fashion site. Ben soon becomes popular with his younger co-workers, including Jules Ostin, the boss and founder of the company. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules. - Robert De Niro, Anne Hathaway, Rene Russo, Anders Holm, JoJo Kushner (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady Heron enrolls at North Shore High School near Chicago after living in Africa. She interacts with Regina George, a prominent student who previously dated Aaron Samuels. Conflict arises when Heron develops an interest in Samuels, leading George to feign a friendship with Heron while attempting to maintain her relationship with Samuels. Both students engage in competitive social behavior that affects the student body. - Lindsay Lohan, Rachel McAdams, Tina Fey, Tim Meadows, Amy Poehler (Comedy)

programme.title: What Women Want
programme.desc: Nick Marshall (Mel Gibson) gets a whole new outlook on life when a fluke accident gives him the ability to read women's minds. At first, this "gift" provides Nick with way too much information, but he begins to realize that he can use it to good effect, especially when it comes to outwitting his new boss, Darcy Maguire (Helen Hunt). - Mel Gibson, Helen Hunt, Marisa Tomei, Mark Feuerstein, Lauren Holly (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Colossal
programme.desc: Gloria is an out-of-work party girl who leaves New York and moves back to her hometown after getting kicked out of her apartment by her boyfriend. When news reports surface that a giant creature is destroying Seoul, South Korea, Gloria gradually comes to the realization that she is somehow connected to this far-off phenomenon. As events begin to spiral out of control, she must figure out why her seemingly insignificant existence is having such a colossal effect on the fate of the world. - Anne Hathaway, Jason Sudeikis, Austin Stowell, Tim Blake Nelson, Dan Stevens (Comedy drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Kara and Tyler are planning on getting married when Tyler's ex-girlfriend returns from rehab, determined to get her life back - starting with Tyler. - Elisabeth Harnois, Morgan Kelly, Kimberly-Sue Murray, Thomas Mitchell, Victoria Sanchez (Thriller)

programme.title: Case 39
programme.desc: In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins (Renée Zellweger) thinks she has seen it all -- until she meets 10-year-old Lilith (Jodelle Ferland) and the girl's cruel parents. When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters. - Renée Zellweger, Jodelle Ferland, Ian McShane, Bradley Cooper, Kerry O'Malley (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop." - David Keith, Drew Barrymore, George C. Scott, Freddie Jones, Heather Locklear (Horror, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: This horror tale focuses on visitors to the secluded mansion of Hill House who have been called to the isolated location by Dr. David Marrow (Liam Neeson) as part of a study on insomnia. However, Marrow is really investigating fear, and he plans to scare the subjects, including the introverted Nell (Lili Taylor) and the seductive Theo (Catherine Zeta-Jones). Unfortunately for Marrow and everyone staying at Hill House, the manor is actually haunted by an evil spirit out to torment its guests. - Liam Neeson, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Owen Wilson, Lili Taylor, Bruce Dern (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Mystery)

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. (Documentary, History, Anthology)

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Peculiar Punishments
programme.desc: S2E13 - One-of-a-kind crimes are often met with one-of-a-kind punishments; like a pig whose bloody rampage lands itself in the courtroom, or a music enthusiast whose wall-rattling beats subject them to hours of classical symphonies. (Documentary, History, Anthology)

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Astonishing Feats
programme.desc: S3E4 - History is full of people pushing the limits, but some are more astonishing than others; like the man who single-handedly liberated a town during World War II; or an epic robbery in Buenos Aires that was pulled off with zero casualties. (Documentary, History, Anthology)

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Unconventional Weapons
programme.desc: S2E8 - People has heard the tales of wars fought with groundbreaking weaponry; learning about everything else in between; from missiles manned by pigeons to an incendiary device made to look like one of America's favorite pastimes. (Documentary, History, Anthology)

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Weird Discoveries
programme.desc: S2E14 - History is riddled with discoveries, from gold, to lost treasures, to scientific findings; some discoveries are anything but ordinary; like severed feet on a beach, or finding evidence of a tiny otherworldly creature; each is weirder than the last. (Documentary, History, Anthology)

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Strangest Places
programme.desc: S3E9 - The world is full of strange and mind-bending places, but some take the cake; explore an island ruled by deadly predators, a Florida town obsessed with the wildest circus performers, or a mysterious paranormal hotspot that's a magnet for UFOs, strange sightings, and baffling disappearances; these are the weirdest corners of the planet you have to see to believe. (Documentary, History, Anthology)

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Incredible Spectacles
programme.desc: S4E3 - From donkey baseball and octopus wrestling to a scientist who swallows uranium, these are the jaw-dropping spectacles that left crowds in awe. (Documentary, History, Anthology)

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Astonishing Beings (New)
programme.desc: S4E4 - The world is full of creatures who make you look twice; from a baboon who becomes a reliable employee at a 19th-century train station, to a Moulin Rouge performer who builds a career on controlled flatulence, to a military combat unit of undeniably adorable pooches; these are the stories of beings so strange, so spectacular, they're unbelievable. (Documentary, History, Anthology)

programme.title: Mysteries From Above - Mysteries of the Sands (New)
programme.desc: S5E4 - In the middle of the Australian outback, a bird's eye view reveals a seemingly endless collection of reddish rocks, and a closer view from above reveals many of these rocks are precariously balanced on top of each other, defying gravity; in a remote corner of Brazil the view from above reveals a desert landscape that defies all logic; a series of endless wavy strips of sand dotted with thousands of blue pools, as if the sea near the Bahamas had suddenly set up shop in the middle of the Sahara. (Documentary)

programme.title: The Nutcracker: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Christmas in Vienna is a dull affair for 9-year-old Mary (Elle Fanning), until her beloved Uncle Albert (Nathan Lane) arrives and gives her a special gift: an enchanted nutcracker. On Christmas night the nutcracker -- named NC -- comes to life and takes Mary to its magical land of sugarplum fairies and talking toys. Mary discovers that the wondrous kingdom faces a dire threat from the evil Rat King, and when the nutcracker is kidnapped, she must rally her new friends to save NC. - Elle Fanning, Nathan Lane, John Turturro, Frances de la Tour, Charlie Rowe (Holiday, Musical, Fantasy)
